description: Use when touching anything security-relevant in a Dotkernel project — authentication, OAuth2 or session login, authorization config and role permissions or guards, CORS, content negotiation, session and cookie settings, error handling and error-reporting endpoints, documentation exposure, secrets and *.local.php versus *.global.php, demo credentials, ownership checks, raw DQL or SQL, or adding a dependency. Also use when reviewing a diff for security problems or when asked whether something is safe to commit.
